compute_nvemd_energy_drift: compute the total energy drift in meV/atom/ps from NVE molecular dynamics trajectory files
calculate_moving_average: calculate a moving average of a numpy array with a configurable window size for smoothing
extract_thermodynamic_drift: extract thermodynamic energy drift from NVE MD simulation output files after equilibration period
join_nvemd_results: join results from multiple NVE MD simulation JSON files into a combined list of drift values
save_nvemd_metrics: save computed NVE MD benchmark metrics including mean energy drift to a JSON file
